title: Chapter 454 Quietly Descended
content:
Chapter 454 Quietly Descended

After the full-strength attack from the Chaos Combined Attack Formation, the Chaos Realm also instantly won a game back.

And at this time outside the Chaos Realm.

Feeling the powerful air waves that erupted in the Chaos Realm, the Divine Eye immediately knew that their people had already died inside.

"This Chaos Realm is really a surprise everywhere."

"But, it's just a stagnant."

He snorted coldly in his eyes, turned around and asked, "Radish, how is the progress?"

However, no one answered.

The divine eyes frowned and looked at the radish-headed creature in front of the black pot, but then the divine eyes were slightly stunned, "Carrot?"

I saw that the radish creature was losing its eyes and bleeding from its seven orifices at this moment.

After a long time, Luobo looked at the divine eyes in the distance, and said softly, "Sir, go."

As soon as the words finished, there was a click.

Radish's body suddenly cracked and there was no vitality.

It was not over yet. With a loud bang, the big pot in front of him also exploded, and a powerful wave of air burst out in the dark void.

The waves of air dissipated, and the face of the divine eyes was solemn, and they were speechless for a long time.

"What's going on?"

The sickle came closer with a sickle carrying the sickle, looking at the divine eyes with confusion.

That carrot is not simple, it is the only genius they brought with them with strange magic. It is a pity that he died just like that.

Facing the questioning of the Scytheitae, his divine eyes shook his head slightly, and his frown still did not relax.

The last words of the carrot were still echoing in his mind.

Walk?

They came to conquer the Chaos Realm in the name of the priest. The mission has not been completed yet, so how could they leave?

It is impossible to leave, but he has also become cautious.

So far, he has seen that this world is extremely extraordinary, and it is different from the world they have conquered.

This world is very special.

After a long silence, my divine eyes took a deep breath and regained their momentum again.

Since this light curtain cannot be broken, let’s just pile up your life.

At worst, you can spend more time. Anyway, the light curtain will disappear sooner or later.

Afterwards, the Divine Eye summoned a group of powerful men from another world and entered the Chaos Realm one after another. Although this behavior is very similar to a behavior of giving away a head, he has no choice so far.

Anyway, they have more soldiers and more generals, so there is no problem with being extravagant.

For them, it is enough to weaken the strength of the Chaos Realm.

How could I know that the divine eyes, who think I am very smart, are facing many things now better than what I am later.

A huge crisis is approaching quietly.

.........

In the vast sea of stars, a figure lies in it, laughing wildly.

"I'm a genius!"

Lu Daosheng was in a good mood. Even when facing a small provocation just now, Lu Daosheng just waved his hand to let the other party have a memory and pay attention to it in the next life.

With the palms spread out, a lifelike and growing world appears.

This is Lu Daosheng's former world in the palm of his hands, which is specially used to cultivate his subordinates to grow rapidly, and it is filled with countless laws and avenues created by himself.

After Lu Daosheng's continuous improvement, this small world has completely taken shape and is no different from the outside world.

"As long as I keep making this world perfect, in the end, the world will be destroyed, and this world will replace the original world and become a future that does not exist in the long run."

Lu Daosheng's eyes shone, staring at the delicate and small world in his palm. His long-standing tense nerves finally relaxed at this moment.

As Lu Daosheng gradually sent it, the entire star sea was trembling slightly.

"Huh~ I don't know, how is the Chaos Realm now?"

"I have left so many backup plans, so there should be no problem, but the time is still a bit tight now."

Lu Daosheng talked to himself and waved his hand casually.

The current battle situation in the Chaos Realm is presented to Lu Daosheng.

"Oh? There is such a wonderful formation. It seems that it was the work of that old guy."

"Well, it's not bad. It's not easy for the Chaos Realm to have the current strength in a short period of time."

Lu Daosheng nodded constantly, his expression of satisfaction.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng's eyes narrowed, and he waved his hand again. The screen switched, and a black passage appeared in front of him. The vast army of foreign countries was heading forward in a mighty manner.

The powerful auras are rising one after another, mixed with chaos and disturbing feelings.

It is the main force of the Land of Gods!

The god's eyes and the sickle weasel brought were just a forward.

But just a forward, the sentient beings in the Chaos Realm were very afraid and had to take measures to solve the problem slowly.

Once the main force of the Land of Gods arrives, it will surely bring a catastrophe to the Chaos Realm.

However, the main force of the land of the gods has not reached, so why is the Chaos Realm the same?

Lu Daosheng groaned and stretched his arms out loud.

Suddenly, dozens of different pictures appeared around Lu Daosheng, surrounding Lu Daosheng.

In these pictures, you can clearly see familiar figures.

Awei, Anxing, Huang Shou, Yunqi and others.

Even Qin Yi, Mu Chen, Xu Qingzhi, Jiang Bei, Yu Qingfeng and others, all familiar figures appeared in it.

"I haven't seen each other for a long time."

Lu Daosheng's eyes were a little emotional. These people were in different worlds, but they all had the same goal.

Improve your strength and conquer the land of the gods.

Almost, it's almost gone.

Lu Daosheng raised his hands and pushed forward, "Then let's help you again."

In an instant, these pictures seemed to have been pressed, and everything around suddenly accelerated.

With one's own strength, only Lu Daosheng can do it.

"And you guys, don't be idle."

Lu Daosheng waved his hand again.

At the same time, in the ruined city of Chaos Realm.

The whole city began to float violently.

Buzz —

Deep in the city lord's mansion, terrifying auras rose, shocking everyone in the deserted city.

"It's the City Lord's Mansion, is it the City Lord?"

Someone exclaimed.

Everyone suddenly looked excited and looked deep in the city lord's mansion.

In the inner city, all the people of the forces stared away, and their qi and blood were boiling.

"Many strong people are worthy of being the city lord's mansion."

"These existences have never been revealed to the world, and it seems that they were the work of the city lord."

"Hahahaha, it seems that the time for a counterattack has come."

With the orders of the ancestors of the three major families, countless heroes in the deserted city suddenly rose up and followed everyone out of the deserted city and headed towards the battlefield.

In the palace of the Lord of the Huangcheng City, countless terrifying auras soared into the sky.

After a brief confusion of eyes, these beings suddenly shone brightly and stared at the sky.

"In the name of the city lord, suppress the land of the gods!"
